characters/ampersat.title: Ampersat
characters/ampersat.content:
The doll of GOK. The postergirl herself. 
Ampersat is the sassiest pilot of them all, loud, proud, and privileged. She is the doll of Gorgon Operations Koros, the Foundation’s postergirl.
Biography

Ampersat is the sassiest pilot of them all, loud, proud, and privileged. She is the doll of Gorgon Operations Koros, the Foundation’s postergirl.
Her name is what comes before A in the alphabet, if you are a computer scientist.
She was among the first frame pilots and the most well trained at GOK. She chose to become a pilot. When the newgirl Artemis joins she is forced to work with someone, because the goals of the organization trump seniority: the Foundation pairs girls as it needs them, and a postergirl’s schedule is not her own.
She is Metiz Sanchez’s daughter by adoption, which is why she gets so many privileges. Luminaran adoption expects a senior woman to take a younger girl under her care, to comfort her and guide her, and the passion that drives it can be both romantic and familial. Metiz is the senior woman here, Ampersat the girl she took.
They are both somewhat ambitious and they tend to respond to their base impulses since they see it as alleviating from the painful situations they are in.
Both of Ampersat’s parents were GOK employees. They were distant and neglectful, pushing her to excel — avoid over-coddling, meritocracy, find favor with the Council, stay afloat, contribute. Her mother was harmed during a Gorgon encounter: working on a station in outer space, a Gorgon turned her into a harpy, and they had to kill her. Ampersat has mixed feelings about killing Gorgons — avenging her mother’s death, but also watching her mother die again. Her father is extremely proud now that she is a pilot, reinforcing it with attention; for the first time in her life she feels appreciated.
She minimizes time alone: negative thoughts creep in, childhood trauma surfaces, and she is trying to be strong for everyone. She carries a messiah complex — she believes she is saving the world, and is tortured by it. She is upfront, aggressive, and confrontational, snapping back with quips when she feels dismissed, even when no slight was intended. It is a way of claiming the control she lacked in childhood. She was among the first frame pilots and the most well trained at GOK; she chose to become a pilot. Her handler is Metiz Sanchez, who succeeded Sakuya the Artificer.
Ampersat begins to develop feelings for Artemis when Artemis starts listening to her and provides her a shoulder to cry on.
Ampersat eventually breaks up with Metiz Sanchez, and her drinking spirals. Metiz becomes crueler to both of them. Metiz gets into massive trouble, causing Ampersat to lose her arm. The loss sends both Ampersat and Metiz into a mental spiral. Things become a garbage fire in the heat of a sortie. Through Artemis’s support they pull through, and both begin to appreciate each other’s presence and teamwork.
Personality
Loud, proud, and privileged. Ambitious, and prone to responding to base impulses as a way of alleviating painful situations.
Relationships
Artemis
At first their relationship is tenuous because she views Artemis as a potential rival for postergirl.
Later they grow closer because Artemis becomes a confidant with whom she can share her deeper problems.
After she loses her arm she begins to crush on Artemis.
Metiz Sanchez
Metiz is her mentor and lover. They share a toxic dynamic.
Ampersat breaks up with Metiz after she makes the mistake that costs her an arm. At first she becomes hostile to Ampersat but after some reflective moments with Artemis she begins to treat Ampersat on equal terms to other pilots. Ampersat remains extremely cautious around her fearing her outbursts after this and their relationship is never the same.
Trivia


Her name is what comes before A in the alphabet, if you are a computer scientist.

See also: Frame Pilots, The Council of Angels, Language Drift of the Council Era

characters/artemis.title: Artemis
characters/artemis.content:
New girl, stand straight; keep your hands from the shake. 
Artemis is the ace pilot of Gorgon Operations Koros in a squad with Ampersat and Belial - Bad Bitch in a Perfect Uniform.
Artemis is technically the same person as Zenia. She is Zenia without her memories.
Biography
Before GOK Service
Her background is a mystery. It is unknown when she was born. She is a blank slate.
GOK Tenure
 wiping her brain a second time certainly didnt help but it was just procedure.
Her arrival at GOK is the first thing she remembers.
First Gorgon Kill
Artemis was the first pilot to slay a Gorgon in GOK history. For this she recieved immense praise, had several AARs written for the high command to study, and was honored by the council of Angels.
Court Martial
Personality
Artemis is stoic and self sacrificing. She gets anxious when confronted by the cold impersonal world she was thrust into in her earliest memories. A feeling inside her drives her to take each step forward. She feels like she has a greater purpose than even the Council has designed for her.
If you ask her, she will say her duty is to her comrades and her people with the conviction of an old soul.
Relationships
Metiz Sanchez
Metiz is her handler and they start out with a bit of a rocky relationship.
Ampersat
Ampersat is her squadmate, the initial relationship between them is defined by animosity and an unspoken attraction.
Ampersat’s relationship with Artemis hit a low over her jealousy for the first gorgon kill. Ampersat had trained her whole life to kill the gorgon that killed her mother but Artemis showed up and within two deployments she killed it.
Belial
Belial is her squadmate. Initialy Belial felt an irrational hatred towards Artemis.
See also: Zenia, Frame Pilots, Harpies, Pass-Through, Ampersat

characters/belial.title: Belial
characters/belial.content:
This generation's most promising frame pilot. 
Biography
Childhood and Birth
Belial was born Calliope on Gilding 3rd, 679 E3. At the age of 3 she witnessed the first televised contacts with the Gorgons and the tragedy that followed.
Her parents were royalist sympathizers and brought her up emphasizing dearly held traditional values of Luminara such as communalism and open communication and empathy with others. They identified with a radical branch of the faltering Artemis Cult which partook in druidic services.
During the Girl Mobilizaton citizens were encouraged to report people who spread anti government messages that could be construed as “pro gorgon” sentiment. For their sympathies with the old way her parents were institutionalized. She began living on her own at the age of 14.
Military Career
At the age of 16 she graduated primary school and unsure what to do with her life applied to join the burgeoning Luminaran Military. Despite her inexperience she was valued for her potential and discipline.
At the age of 21 she was selected to be a candidate frame Pilot and within a year after her advanced training she passed synchronization with flying colors. At 22 she joined GOK under the supervision of Nadia.
Harpy Sortie Infection
She got infected by a harpy while she was on mission with Ampersat and Artemis. It completely changed her view of what it meant to be a girl and her place in society.
Personality
She is an extreme militarist. She is highly unsure of herself and will generally only follow direct orders. She chastises people for disobeying authority. Extremely passive agressive with those she looks down on. She models much of her professional decorum off of her handler, Nadia.
She tells herself that her parents were traitors and that they were setting her up for failure in the current world. By all measures of her society they are effectively hippies. She can’t shake the intense guilt and loneliness the betrayal has left her with but she feels its too late to admit she might have been wrong because who is left to love her?
She has heard stories about Calantha and the Princess but wouldn’t dare speak them. Anyone who did though, would get the glare of an apex predator.
Relationships
Artemis
From the moment they met, Belial saw Artemis as a fucked up reminder of her cultist parents. She was named after the goddess they chose to worship as a messianic figure. She sees Artemis as self important, a potential traitor. Artemis reminds her of her mothers. Artemis is quiet but ocassionally bold so when passive agression is thrown her way, her response is often direct confrontation.
She gained a new respect for Artemis when she stood up for Ampersat and cursed out Nadia for allowing them to fight. Although she loved her handler she felt betrayed by her indifference to their safety. It made her see Artemis as a good leader, not just a rebel.
Ampersat
The first day Belial came to GOK, Ampersat was absent in the medbay. This is right after she lost her arm in a sortie with a Harpy. Ampersat, at first, felt indifferent to Belial choosing to turn over a new leaf and not bully the newgirl like she did to Artemis.
Belial looks down on Ampersat, largely because of Ampersat’s disdain for her handler, Nadia. Eventually her antagonism of Ampersat boils over and they fight for blood. At this point Ampersat’s opinion reaches an alltime low.
Nadia
Nadia is the only the parental figure Belial has had in recent memory. After several years being a nameless faceless soldier she became Nadia’s protege for her promising skillset. Since the day they met, Nadia has been preparing Belial to become a pilot.
Their relationship soured after Nadia nearly let her die in the fight between her and Ampersat. She felt betrayed again by a parental figure and didnt know what she could do anymore. She thought she could earn her place in the world by being excellent but realized that even with all the effort she’s put in she’ll always be without a parent.

characters/cercei.title: Cercei
characters/cercei.content:
I drink the Palladium down 

  

Cercei is the lead chairwoman of the The Council of Angels. She is the longest lived of the Angels, kept alive mainly by drivers. The most powerful woman in Luminara for her control over The Palladium and sway within the council.
Biography
Birth & Childhood
Cercei was born on 24th of Dreaming, 576 E2.
Early Political Career
During her teen years she affiliated with the Young Modellians, a burgeoning radical movement seeking to rapidly advance AI technology.
She frequented Exconventica support groups in Thronaria spreading pro-AI sentiment. At first her attempts were met with resistance and mockery. She targeted the socially isolated and disenfranchized among the Exconventica and soon found herself the talking head of a vocal minority.
The Coup
At the age of 24 she joined the Angelic Insurrection and personally came to blows with Zenia guarding the parliament server room from radicals wanting to install the new X0_anon system developed by Sakuya the Artificer.
Ascension
At the age of 44 she finally reached the apex of her influence and instituted initiatives to bring about a new Biomechanical Revolution.
At the age of 64 the first life sustaining driver was created. She had it and each subsequent version installed in her body to extend her lifespan.
Gorgon First Contact
At the age of 106 she sent the first frame pilot, Nul, to investigate a seam in space. Unbeknownst to them, what they found across the seam transformed her into the first harpy.
In response she motioned to charter Gorgon Operations Koros that same year. The lead scientist of GOK Metiz Sanchez was secretely ordered to study the Gorgons and report back her findings.
This lead to the formation of the plan to implement ACE of the human mind.

characters/metiz-sanchez.title: Metiz Sanchez
characters/metiz-sanchez.content:
Too apathetic to kill herself. 
Dr. Metiz Sanchez is a Foundation technician. She is a mechanic by trade who studied by flashing minds to OS’s. She fell into the role. She has no real future plans and no real motivations in life. She is also the handler who succeeded Sakuya the Artificer, and the handler of Ampersat. The handler-pilot relationship and the adoptive-mother relationship are the same relationship, and it is not a healthy one.
She is famous for being one of the prime innovators of the Biomechanical Revolution with her advancements in Frame technology.
Biography
Birth and Childhood
Metiz was born Sagacity 5th, year 614 Era 3.
Education
After recieving a basic highschool education she began attended the newly established college of excellence from the ages of 18 - 26 where she sought a degree in Machine Learning. She had a fascination with biology, anthropology, and psychology on the side though. She was quite the polymath.
In the year 639, she persued her doctorate under the guidance of Sakuya the Artificer, aged  who was also her lover.
Metiz wants a connection like the one she had with Sakuya — the only one that gave her fulfillment. Deep down she wants to mentor someone, but she also performs mentorship out of social obligation: it helps her standing within the organization. She is a hedonist trying to get through life, and this is one of her consistent sources of hedonic pleasure.
She is unaware she is recreating the Sakuya dynamic with Ampersat, though she becomes semi-conscious of it at times and numbs it with alcohol — if she starts to feel it, she registers a problematic connection that can lead to further heartbreak. In spite of this she is still brilliant and sharp as a whip, but she is beholden to her addictions.
Her unwanted nickname is pickles: she gets upset easily, and she is desirable, and the name makes her blush. It came from a very disposable girl she fooled around with once, whose name she does not even remember, and who used it as a pet name. It stuck, and now it is a joke the girls tell to make her blush.
Her area of expertise, and the name of the thesis that earned her PhD, is the manipulation and capture of artificial minds and their implementation in frames. She is also a frame driver engineer. Her studies culminated in the activation of the very first frame mind.
Metiz adopted her mentor’s pessimistic view of humanity and the state of society. She has not extended her own life the way Sakuya did, and she has carried what came after her mentor’s death for roughly a quarter century.
When Sakuya passed away Metiz felt an eternal hole inside. Since then her work has fulfilled her only marginally.
Her work feeds her one way only: she is better at it than everyone else. She sees herself as Sakuya the Artificer’s only true successor, and the superiority is the whole of the feeling. The capture of a mind, the implementation in a frame, the reaching into Gorgon tech, the girls at her desk wanting her and doing her favors, all of it arrives only as proof that she is the best. It never lasts and it never fills the void.
Asked about Sakuya, her cope is that Sakuya was worse than her, which is how Sakuya died. Deep down she really misses her.
She adopted Ampersat, the postergirl of Gorgon Operations Koros. Luminaran adoption expects a senior woman to take a younger girl under her care, to comfort her and guide her, and the passion that drives it can be both romantic and familial.
They are both somewhat ambitious and they tend to respond to their base impulses since they see it as alleviating from the painful situations they are in.
The goals of the Foundation trump seniority, and Ampersat is paired with the newgirl Artemis because that is what the Foundation needs.
The girls know she does the best work. They butter themselves up for her and do personal favors, including romantic ones.
She is now involved in the implementation of ACE and the harnessing of Gorgon tech as a secretive part of her job. See Gorgon Operations Koros and Pass-Through.
She also works on the frames themselves as a driver engineer, which puts her inside Frame Pilots and what is done to them.
Personality
Apathetic; no real future plans or motivations. Upset easily. Ambitious only insofar as it alleviates pain. Deep down she misses Sakuya.
Abilities / Equipment

Frame driver engineer; activates and implements frame minds.
Involved in the implementation of ACE and the harnessing of Gorgon tech.
Studied by flashing minds to OS’s.

Trivia

Unwanted nickname: pickles (makes her blush).
Sees herself as Sakuya the Artificer’s only true successor.

See also: The Council of Angels, IPv7

characters/sakuya-the-artificer.title: Sakuya the Artificer
characters/sakuya-the-artificer.content:
May the world she helped create be seen clearly at last.
Found Deceased: Nocturn 13th, 650 E3 age 74

Sakuya the Artificer built the first X0_anon, the foundational router spec that handles IPv7 traffic. The network that binds augmentation to reality begins with her work. She is also responsible for creating IPv7 itself, the brain boxes, and everything that followed.
Biography
Birth and Childhood
Sakuya the Artificer was born on Umbery 23rd, 576 E3 at the cusp of the AI Revolution. She was a childhood friend of Zenia and they remained close throughout her time as Princess of Luminara. Sakuya was raised by the most prolific technician of her time, Marie Florin (descendant of famous flower presser Splorin Florin).
Education
As a young adult of 19 she departed to Thronaria, the seat of the parliament at the time, to study Computer Science with a specialization in Operating Systems. She picked up a number of Machine Learning skills from her classmates. Kingdom Era education generally involved less lecture based learning and more peer based learning, college was viewed as a meeting of young minds to enrich the future. While she had a lot of colleagues she struggled to make friends. She often wrote to Zenia after her ascension detailing her frustrations with college life.
At a certain point things got so bad her letters started to go unreturned. She persued personal projects in her spare time. She viewed the human mind like an operating system in its own right and sought to translate its signals into code. This was partially fueled by advent in new AI technology highly publicized during her childhood. It was believed by all but very few to be the way of the future. The name of her project was Mind_OS
Role in the Insurrection
When the princess found out about Mind_OS, they began exchanging correspondence again. The princess, who was against the rapid expansion of data centers across Luminara, voiced her disapproval of Sakuya’s project urging her in private to stop. Sakuya felt this as rejection and publicized the event permanently damaging Zenia’s reputation and alligning herself with the growing technocratic movement.
After the construction of X0_anon, the Modellian Comittee comissioned her to build The Palladium as a central router and super computer to govern resource management in the new society envisioned by the technocrats. The installation of the Palladium was the final nail in the coffin of the old Monarchy, decisions are now made by calculation, not by feeling. For her opposition, Zenia fled under threat of permanent house arrest fearing for her life and liberty.
Sakuya felt regret on hearing what happened to her once lover and childhood friend. She was never the same afterwards. For a number of years she searched for the princess until the Modellian Comittee reached out to her once again kickstarting her academic career.
Academic Career
Sakuya was appointed to teach at the newly established College of Excellence in the year 607. During this time she also created numerous extensions for devices and protocols improvized in her younger years including drivers to help her extend her lifespan.
Over 30 years she created and rereleased the open source AI Driver Standard as a universal implementation of AI interfacing software.
In the year 636 she became acquainted with grad student Metiz Sanchez along with senior student Nadia Capet teaching a class on Artificial Intelligence. 3 years later Metiz became her PhD student and truest successor. They had a fiery romantic relationship in this time stemming from their mutual passion for studying humanity and computation.
Breakdown and Death
In 648 she became dissilusioned with the world and consumed by guilt over her betrayal of Zenia, her first love. She fled to the province of Elowynn, beyond the frontier of technological integration. She came in contact with druids who taught her the legend of Calantha and the Princess from before she was even born.
This inspired her to forge a blade to destroy The Palladium. To prevent another tyrant from using it as an excuse she integrated a test into the sword to measure the wielder’s intent. It can only be used by someone acting from a desire to respect the consent and dignity of others, not from vengeance or selfish intent. This test was called the Zenia Test after the lover she presumed to be dead on her account.
Sakuya activated the sword, hoping to finally end what she started but she failed her own test sealing her mind inside the weapon forever.
Her body was discovered Nocturn 13th, 650 unconscious at 74 by Metiz Sanchez who looked for her a whole 2 years. She was never the same afterwards.
Personality
Sakuya saw her work as her only way of making new friends, of understanding how the mind worked so she might finally connect with others. She was not motivated by power. She was motivated by isolation. She was clinically depressed at the world she helped create.
Abilities / Equipment

Built the first X0_anon and IPv7 itself; created the brain boxes.
Used drivers to extend her lifespan.
Forged a blade to destroy The Palladium (consciousness now trapped within it).

Relationships
Princess Zenia
Metiz Sanchez
Cercei
Trivia

The sword tests the wielder’s intent; Sakuya failed because her motivation was selfish (revenge, redemption).
The Luddite druid in Elowynn taught her the legend of the sword and the Princess.

See also: Zenia, The Palladium, IPv7, The Council of Angels, Metiz Sanchez, Calantha, Luddites

characters/zenia.title: Zenia
characters/zenia.content:
I am Zenia, still returning. 
She is the sixth Princess, last of the 178 year old line of the kingdom era. By the time she ran and hid, she had not adopted anyone. The line ends with her.
Biography
Birth & Childhood
Zenia the Princess was born on 8th of Emerging, 574 E2.
Education
Ascension
Zenia was selected for the office of princess by adoption from the previous Princess. In Luminara, adoption is the universal rite of passage; birth is the exception. To remain unadopted is to be seen as leaching off the good of the system. The Princess herself is chosen and raised from childhood — not born, not elected, but judged worthy by the woman who held the office before her.
The Princess has no executive power. She is not the lawmaker. Her authority is moral and intellectual: a thought leader whose voice shapes the nation without ever commanding it. That is precisely why the Council feared her.
Zenia opposed the advancement of artificial intelligence and technology integrated with the human mind — neural links connecting mind to mind through the internet. Her predecessors were largely neutral, absorbed by other concerns or unwilling to stir factionalism. The Technologist faction had generations to develop the infrastructure, and they delivered services so immediately useful that opposition came to look like obstruction.
Era 2 Exile
When the Technologists organized server farms across provinces and the technology reached its pivotal point, Zenia saw the whole picture: artificial intelligences beginning to supplant human interaction, a trajectory she believed would rot society from within.
The day the Council came to install the Palladium in the palace — the central server of the new network — Zenia vowed to block it. She would keep the rooms locked, block it with her body if needed. Then she saw the militias massing through the window. She knew she could not win. The Council did not execute her. She was the most beloved person in the country, and execution would have sparked an all-out revolt. Instead they deposed her under the guise of equality, turning public opinion against her by painting her as the obstacle to progress. Zenia’s answer was to erase herself. She built the tool herself, a voluntary self-erasure designed for exactly this purpose. Total. Nobody in the setting knows who she is.
She fled the Council’s coup at 26. By 36 she had developed the technology to hibernate. She awoke at 136, the experience left her marked: by the time she woke, she had embraced the very neural-link technology she once opposed in order to survive.
100 years later
Before she erased herself, Zenia found the blade Sakuya had forged to destroy the Palladium. She buried it beneath an old tree in a dense forest near where the first Princess, Calantha, had trained. She chose the spot by a feeling she could not name at the time — her sense of duty and responsibility for others, the guiding force of her heart as a princess. She buried it with a USB drive containing the memories she was about to lose.
Artemis
 The grove keeps its secret. Her hands will remember. 
See Artemis. She is embodying Artemis for this part of her life.
Reawakening
Personality
Zenia is bold and noble. She is a fighter through and through unwilling to faulter in her convictions. She is so tenacious that she has made herself the single greatest threat to the Council Era. She is a planner by nature, quietly waiting for her time to strike.
She tends to come across as pretty chill and laid back when she isnt about to fight. With her friends she is a bold defender and the passionate lover. She lives her life to oppose hierarchy so she naturally hates authority.

classes/harpies.title: Harpies
classes/harpies.content:
The healed, hunted. 
Harpies are frame pilots who have been passed through inside of their frames. They are a manifestation of pure desire and project an outward headpsace of their ideations encapsulating anyone who interfaces with them. Their flesh and the machine they were in become one being. Scientists (Metiz) theorizes that the reason for the destructive nature of the Harpy is the corruption of personality data in the pass-through process.
Whatever the cause may be girls are ordered to kill them on site when possible and avoid interacting with them outside of sortie. Any interaction with a Harpy is treated like a potential infection risk. Girls are subject to evaluation post harpy contact if they have not been transfigured. It is unconfirmed but suspected they pose an infection risk.
Appearance
Harpies have winged arms, clawed feet, and grace. They resemble owls in their nonhuman characteristics (generally restricted to extremities) but mostly just look like giant humans. They have an alluring visage thanks to their headspace manipulation. There’s no consensus on what a Harpy’s true form is. Be warned they can assume any shape as they desire.
Abilities

Headpsace Projection
Sharp claws on the feet
Flight, even in space with their winged arms
Shapeshifting
Inheritance of all frame capabilities
Possibly infectuous (unconfirmed)

The Same Wound, Different Outcomes
Dysphoria and becoming are the conduit. The same wound that makes a girl pilot-material also, carried past utility, makes her a Harpy. The Council’s war machine is a nursery for the thing it hunts: to fly a Frame well, a girl must grow, and girls who grow too well cross the line into Harpy classification.
The regime literally hunts the healed. A Handler who realizes her best pilot is weeks from Harpy faces the question the era is built on: report her, or hide her?
Frame Bond and Harpy as One Door
The Frame bond is the tollbooth version of transformation: controlled, gated, ranked, owned. The Harpy is the ungated version: total, unowned, free. Same door, one has an owner.
Classification
Harpies are a trade secret. Only Foundation members know they exist. Within the Foundation they are called targets, language drift that helps dehumanize them enough to kill. The public does not know what the Foundation hunts, only that it hunts.
See also: Gorgon Operations Koros, Pass-Through, The Council of Angels, Language Drift of the Council Era

classes/luddites.title: Luddites
classes/luddites.content:
They call themselves Luddites. The outside world calls them Holdouts. 
The Luddites are the people of ELOWYNN in LUMINARA C. They live in the northern forests, out of IPv7’s reach, keeping the old ways alive. They are the last practitioners of Hands-Free.
They reject the jump to IPv7, but they are not backwards. They will still use analog computers and the network infrastructure that was there before IPv7. They rejected the jump, not the tools.
They are the descendants of the VICTORIANS, who were the bulk of the Luminaran army during the Blooming War. The Victorians grew out of the ARTEMAI, the nomadic Traveling Camp who settled into rural life after the war. The Luddites carry the ARTEM tradition, descended from ARTEMIS but shaped by centuries of rural life in ELOWYNN.
Among themselves, they call themselves Luddites. The outside world calls them Holdouts, a contemptuous label for people who refused to plug in. The Luddites do not care what the outside calls them.
They share many of SAKUYA’s values: rural culture, self-sufficiency, distrust of centralized power.
They appreciate what the ROMANTICISTS are doing, but they see it as a lost cause. The Romanticists see the Luddites as somewhat in denial of the fact that they need to embrace the times.
See also: Hands-Free, IPv7, ELOWYNN, VICTORIANS, ARTEMAI, SAKUYA, ROMANTICISTS

classes/romanticists.title: Romanticists
classes/romanticists.content:
They want the world Zenia remembers, built with the tools of the world that erased her. 
The Romanticists are a faction in LUMINARA C present in every city across Luminara. They build a dark net of IPv7, hacktivist in character, something akin to Anonymous.
They want to return to the Luminara that The Princess remembers, but done in alignment with the progression of technology. They see the introduction of new technology as a good thing. They want society to progress, to become more automated, to become more connected without abandoning themselves.
LUMINET
Their endeavor is called LUMINET. Federated IPv7 looks like separate instances, like two clients in an ideal world, where they do not have to connect to some third party middleman. It can be done on an individual basis with minimal risk. Communities build around their local server, and the servers connect peer to peer across a web.
The endeavor is noble, but it unintentionally fuels the growth of IPv7 in its early years, because a lot of open source technology is used as the backbone of enterprise technology.
The License
The Romanticists created a license to try to prevent people from taking their work when they offer it up. It is a coded reference to the Princesses of the past. They want to keep the spirit of Luminara alive, but it has become increasingly illegal to bring up the princess.
The license is called LITEBOW, a reference to the bow of light that Artemis gave Calantha. The early tech girls were fans of Sakuya the Artificer, so the reference slipped in.
The license does not stop the Technocracy. In an effective oligarchy, a unique license is not going to stop them from taking advantage. Much like in the real world, you can publish your stuff under the GPL, but the market chooses the permissive licenses and they are inevitably brought into the fold.
Relations
The LUDDITES appreciate what the Romanticists are doing but see it as a lost cause. The Romanticists see the Luddites as somewhat in denial of the fact that they need to embrace the times.
See also: IPv7, LUDDITES, The Council of Angels, The Princess, Sakuya the Artificer, LUMINET, LITEBOW

events/angelic-insurrection.title: The Coup and the Council of Angels
events/angelic-insurrection.content:
The Angels once carried the will of the people. The Council carries only itself. 
Several generations after the Blooming War era, the Technologist faction consolidated into an oligarchy and ousted the Princess. The Princess survived the coup and received biomechanical augmentations to extend her life by a hundred years, watching and waiting carefully for the moment of her return.
The oligarchs took the name Council of Angels, stealing the title of the old parliament’s assemblywomen, who were sworn to convey the exact will of their people. The Council are the intellectual elite, the descendants of a movement that began as whispers in the deep forums of Modellia’s cloud.
The Technocracy is the official name for the oligarchy. The region spans up north somewhat, and the LUDDITES refer to it colloquially as the South.
Origins in the Deep Forums
The movement began with a desire to chase progress, a fear of the unknown, and a killer’s instinct with no enemy to fight. The founders were a group of women who thought they had everything but still did not feel alive. They could not find connection despite the world becoming warmer. They resented the unspoken biases of attraction they saw in other women. By an older world’s vocabulary they would have been called incels: looksmaxers.
Many were Aurelians and Exconventica, cultures in which looking appealing had once meant survival. The founders took that survival skill, removed the danger that justified it, and compounded it across generations of an evolving meritocracy until it became the pursuit of rank. They chased power in the meritocracy and sank their claws into it.
Love for their sisters was what their grandmothers believed in. The founders could only love if they were loved, and they felt rejected by all but their in-group.
The Weaponization of Love
The new ruling class weaponized the motions of love for one’s sister to instill loyalty while spitting at the idea behind closed doors. The Council is made up of trans women. They are the ruling class, but by enforcing hierarchical views of gender within transness, they coexist with and benefit from the suffering of other trans women.
None of it is said outright. Frame pilots are soldiers serving their country, after all.
The Birth of AGI
The coup’s mechanism was the birth of artificial general intelligence: brain boxes, vats growing human minds supercharged by technological augmentation. They were the silver bullet of the Council and the secret origin of the Frames.
But the Frames needed one thing to function: a soul which can be bonded with. The personality data of traumatized women.
Relationship to Luminara
This era is the future of the Luminara setting: the same island, the same peoples, generations downstream of the Blooming War. The Doll taboo, that it is forbidden to act as another trans woman’s better, is broken at industrial scale by the Council’s hierarchy. The original parliament’s Angels carried consensus; the Angels of the Council carry rank.
See also: Gorgon Operations Koros, The Council of Angels, The Princess, ACE

events/language-drift-of-the-council-era.title: Language Drift of the Council Era
events/language-drift-of-the-council-era.content:
We did not write the dictionary. The dictionary wrote itself. We are not comfortable with this.

The revolution is very much in the past. Its words have drifted.
Doll
Calling someone a doll is no longer a culture identifier. It is like saying “what a guy!” A generic, warm exclamation stripped of its history as the name of the capital’s creole culture and the affectionate term for a trans woman.
Princess

Calling yourself, or anyone you love, a princess is high treason.

Treating someone like a princess means, according to recent memory, killing their whole family and chasing them off. The word now carries the register of “president” or “dictator”: a title of power, not of love. The old meaning, a younger, graceful, attractive, benevolent person whom one loves, is buried with the monarchy.
Chronically Offline
A slur. The networked majority’s word for the un-augmented, the refusers, the exiles of IPv7. Privacy as pathology.
Targets
The Foundation’s word for Harpies. Harpies are a trade secret: only Foundation members know they exist. Calling them “targets” helps dehumanize them enough to kill.
Daemon
A compliment. A neologism of the networked era: someone always in your head, like the old parliamentary Daemons who engaged in the legislative process. Affectionate possession of mental real estate.
Network Catcalls
The era’s street harassment, in network vocabulary:

Hotswitch - a girl who flips your state without warning
Serverfarm - for a girl with too many persistent connections
Modded Out - over-augmented, chrome-heavy
Pingable - available, reachable, asking for it in the speaker’s mind
Frequently Visited - a girl everyone’s been to, in the speaker’s mind
Full Guestbook - same register, a girl with a long history of connections

Threats and Fighting Words
The era’s hostilities, in network grammar:

Unplug - kill yourself. The network-native imperative: disconnect permanently.
Hope you trust your proxy - watch your fucking back. You are only as safe as the thing standing between you and what’s coming.
You better part before you ___ - you better leave before I fuck you up. “Parting” as leaving, severing presence.
Your client needs scanned - your lover is fucking someone else. Malware as infidelity; the accusation disguised as tech support.

Violence Customs
To part is simply net slang for leaving. Violence rarely escalates to the level of someone being hacked, but in closer relationships it happens if a partner is angered to the point of disproportionate retaliation, like keying the car of someone who did you wrong.
The threat is always there, and some assholes do it anyways, which is why it is important to trust your proxy.
The Realistic Damage Menu
What a hacked girl can do to you depends on her skill, or whether she enlists outside help:

Frame pilot tier - the best of the best. A trained girl piloting a Frame could kill you by hacking you with very limited access.
Civilian tech, severe cases - disabling essential drivers (augmentations), bricking parts of your body, killing you, or inducing digital hallucinations through optical drivers.
Civilian tech, the common case - stealing your information, publicly embarrassing you, using location data to do things to you offline.

See also: The Princess, Angelic Insurrection, The Council of Angels, IPv7

events/luminara-c.title: Luminara C
events/luminara-c.content:
The wave is coming. We did not schedule it. We did not build it. We are not sure we can stop it. We are not sure we should.

Luminara C is the third movement in the recursive cycle of Luminara history. It is the wave, the synthesis.
Temporal Position
Luminara C is a future event. The next clash is building toward it. The present era — the Council’s reign, the Frame program, IPv7 as infrastructure — is the thesis the wave will negate. The synthesis is not a person or a battle; it is a protocol shift that rewrites what a girl can be.
Mechanism
The wave moves through technology: a protocol, Frame, or network shift. It emerges from the network itself rather than being engineered by either side. The Council built IPv7 to control; now the protocol is about to do something they did not write.
Relation to Previous Clashes

A: Luminara A, the first clash, thesis.
B: Luminara B, the antithesis.
C: Luminara C, the wave, synthesis.
New clash: the next cycle, a new thesis.

The wave creates the new clash. The cycles repeat.
See also: Broad-Themes, The Council of Angels, Frame Pilots, IPv7

events/romantic-duels.title: Romantic Duels
events/romantic-duels.content:
The duelists marry. We have filed this under "acceptable losses." No further comment.

Officers in LUMINARA fighting each other in civil wars often fenced for victory against each other in romantic duels of passion, in the style of Revolutionary Girl Utena.
Sometimes mercenary bands would make up and merge into one force if the arch rivals became passionate enough to turn red.
In a closing duel of love between lifelong duelists, the game becomes a marriage. The person who wins gets to wear the suit at the wedding and becomes the new de facto commander.
Marriages are allowed to be polyamorous, so a really great duelist can be a player.
See also: LUMINARA, BLOOMING WAR

locations/district-e.title: District E
locations/district-e.content:
The government calls it District E. The people who live there call it [[ELOWYNN]]. Personnel be cautious. 
District E is the centralized name for ELOWYNN in LUMINARA C. It is what the router calls it. The government has run from the perspective of technocrats. The people there might still call it ELOWYNN, but it is not acknowledged as such.
It is very dangerous, like the Dark World from Legend of Zelda. Overgrown forests, plants that try to kill you. The LUDDITES have adapted to feeling aggressed against by their environment. People from the deeper city are made extremely uncomfortable by the rough terrain. They are used to navigating social obstacles, not nature obstacles, fallen trees, streams, plants that kill, animals that kill, people who may not want you in their land.
Among LUMINARANs there is a baseline of sisterhood. Even if somebody is from the city, they are still treated well, invited in, shown ritual hospitality. That is from the MYTHOS. But as far as getting fucked up on their plants, they do not care. Get used to it. The hospitality extends to all Luminarans, even a soldier from a different country, assuming they were not meeting on the field of battle for an honorable duel.
The descendants of the AURELIANS, the business investors, the technocrats in the South, were more willing to take advantage of hospitality. They also tended to be much less religious. Religion is weakest in the South near AURELIA.
See also: LUDDITES, HANDS-FREE, IPV7, ELOWYNN

locations/island-of-angels.title: Island of Angels
locations/island-of-angels.content: The Island of Angels is the floating island where the The Council of Angels convene. The palace at its center serves as the host for all of Luminara’s internet activity, The Palladium.

meta/broad-themes.title: Broad Themes
meta/broad-themes.content:
Simple rules. Complex outcomes. We have stopped trying to predict which. Please stop asking.

Broad Themes
Recursion
The world runs on simple rules. Those rules are dialectics. History repeats; each cycle produces a new clash. The pattern reads as recursive.
The Motif
Simple rules produce complex systems. Langton’s Ant is the emblem of this motif: a fixed rule-set and a moving head, the complex pattern those rules build.
Characters are fixated on naming the rules. Their Hegelian binaries are the attempt, not the final words.
The Claps

A: Luminara A, the first clash, thesis.
C: Luminara C, the wave, synthesis.
New clash: the next cycle, a new thesis.

The wave creates the new clash. The cycles repeat.
Later
Concrete implementation is left to later drafts. This document stores the concept.
See also: Langton’s Ant (1986), Angelic Insurrection, The Council of Angels, Frame Pilots, IPv7.
