lyrics/luminara,-i-remembered-you.title: Luminara, I Remembered You
lyrics/luminara,-i-remembered-you.content:
Prev: The Blade that Breaks the Palladium
Background
Final song in the musical. A celebration and resolution of Zenia’s journey. She realizes she’s not just the her she started as, she’s more than one person. She’s lost so many people but she carries on the one thing she set out on a quest to preserve. Luminara, you live inside of us forever.
Lyrics
[Verse 1]
The Palladium fell with the rain
Cercei’s decrepit hand went still
I stood where the long night lost its claim
And wondered if I ever will
I carried names through iron years
Some hands I held, some slipped away
I swore this hour would never come
Still kept a place for hope to stay in me
[Pre-Chorus]
At the gate, that old note stirs
A measured step, a lifted chin
The name I chose when I was emptied
Comes walking home beneath my skin
We win
[Chorus]
Luminara, I remembered you
Gold on the river, doors thrown wide
We paid in comrades, years, and tears
But now we have you back again
I am Zenia, I am Artemis
And something loved that time has taken
The battle’s done; both names remain
We bear them forward, unforgotten
[Verse 2]
I hear the cedar spring run clear
The blade laid down beneath the moss
The girl who woke beside the gate
Still lives in every choice I’ve crossed
More than a princess, more than a soldier
More than what the years made me
Two lives held steady in one heart
And one more place for the new me
[Pre-Chorus]
At the gate, the old tune turns
A quiet vow becomes my own
I meet the self I couldn’t know
And claim the path we made alone
[Chorus]
Luminara, I remembered you
Wild growin’ forests, doors thrown wide
We pave the future and build new homes
We live for those whose lives were lost
I am Zenia, I am Artemis
And something loved that time has taken
The battle’s done; the names remain
We bear them forward, unforgotten
[Bridge]
We thought this day belonged to dreams
A far-off shore beyond the flame
Yet history’s doomed to repeat
Though none of us could name the day
The old times open fire and take aim
We cannot step outside the years
We’ll live with what that age has made
And keep its pain in our care
[Final Chorus]
Luminara, I remembered you
Our hearts keeps their open doors
The Exconventica were broken then
We must all never forget
I am Zenia, I am Artemis
And all the strength it took to gather
every comrade gone, and look ahead
We make a world that holds their names
[Outro]
At the gate, I stand as her
The cedar keeps what time can’t sever
Luminara, I remembered you
Your spirit lives in us forever
Style Prompt
Psychedelic rock with blues-rock and acid-rock color: expressive vintage tube-guitar bends, swirling organ carrying a recurring Artemis motif, warm bass, and steady live drums, The user’s own recorded female voice moves from intimate remembrance to weathered, triumphant clarity, with rich chorus harmonies, Expansive analog warmth, roomy drums; reflective opening builds into a celebratory full-band final chorus and decisive ending, with a steady classic-rock pulse

Stage Direction

Lyrics
[Verse 1]
We planted lilacs in assembly halls
And left the gates unbarred at dusk
My mothers taught the young to read the stars
And every name was spoken just
[Pre-Chorus]
Then came the quiet hands behind the glass
The Council with its borrowed wings
They promised every boundless self at last
But held the keys to everything
[Chorus]
Luminara, I remember you
Women from the convent opened doors
They crowned the future, called it new
Sent mercenaries through our halls
I ran with your last ember burning
Past the servers, past the guns
I am Zenia, still returning
I will find the blade that comes
[Verse 2]
The years became a thousand locked machines
The poor bowed down to rented code
They wired private thoughts between their skin
And sold each heartbeat by the node
[Pre-Chorus]
They taught the girls to leave themselves behind
To cleanse their hearts and steer the steel
They called the Gorgons sickness of the mind
I saw the worlds they made were real

Luminara, I remember you

No veteran lived without a home
I survive with your last ember burning
Off the servers, all alone
I am Zenia, still returning

Cercei says the soul responds to she
That every truth belongs to her

A a single namespace that will not blur
Beautiful, adored, beyond defeat
A life made whole by one command
But no one gets to name us complete
No god, nor lord, can own the land

Luminara, I remember you
Though gray towers veil the dawn
The Palladium can be undone
The gate can break; the spell can stop
I kept your ember through the ages
Through the cold and broken ones
I am Zenia, turn the pages
I will bring the morning sun
[Outro]
I will bring the morning sun
Luminara, I remember you

lyrics/nuei-attica.title: Nuei Attica
lyrics/nuei-attica.content:
Prev: Artemis at the Gate
Next: Ampersat, the Sign before A
Background
Artemis, fresh out of conditioning gives her first impression of Gorgon Operations Koros main base Nuei Attica. It is when we are introduced to Metiz Sanchez and Ampersat for the first time.
Lyrics
[Verse 1]
They say this base was built on Socrates’ grave
A stone name under corridors scrubbed clean
Mission control watched the maps redraw
Frames waiting in their launch-bay sheen
I learned the exits, counted every door
Kept my questions folded out of mind
A training floor, bright steel and white tile
Showers steaming into morning light
[Pre-Chorus]
The mess hall served the whole crew
Pilot or not, we took our place
Then came the clinic, measured glass
Metiz the handler’s patient face
[Verse 2]
“A cocktail keeps the girls composed,” Metiz said
“Your dose goes up when you resist
Best stay in line, Artemis. You’ll find
It’s easier not to make the list.”
I watched the needle, watched her hands
The elder girl looked broken in her heart
A stranger’s glance, a quiet map
I carried it all along
[Chorus]
Nuei Attica, death below us
Names beneath the polished floor
I keep still and take it in
While they decide what I am for
Nuei Attica, hold your silence
Every hallway has its eyes
I won’t show them what I’m thinking
I’ll learn the shape of every lie
[Verse 3]
Ampersat stood at the threshold, looking past the lights
“Ampersat, our first doll here”
She colored at the word, then gave a small, careful nod
A darling word from older days
She spoke it like a private crown
[Bridge]
She looked me over, cool and neat
“So you’re the new one. Tell me, dear—
Do you always watch before you speak,
Or is that only when I’m near?”
I said, “I’m learning who’s in charge.”
She smiled, “Then keep your notes precise.”
Her gaze stayed longer than it had to
Her voice went soft around the ice
[Final Chorus]
Nuei Attica, stone below us
Names beneath the polished floor
She can test me, she can size me
I can still ask what she’s waiting for
Nuei Attica, hold your silence
Every hallway has its eyes
I won’t show them what I’m thinking—
[Outro]
Sirens cut across the church
“Its a Gorgon!” All the doors unlock
The ladies turn; I follow close
The launch lights start to count down
Style Prompt
Dark electropop, measured industrial pulse opening into urgent driving drums; sparse low piano, muted mechanical percussion, clipped synth bass and ticking metallic textures, brief choral hush, delicate strings rising into urgent strings; close female lead in a poised, cutting delivery with intimate call-and-response; sharply shifting scene dynamics, precise modern mix, unresolved final hit

lyrics/palladium-fever.title: Palladium Fever
lyrics/palladium-fever.content:
Prev: The Dark that Wears my Face
Next: Artemis at the Gate
Background
A song from Cercei’s perspective explaining her reason for wanting ACE which she describes in abstract terms as breakcore interrupts her thinking and causes her words to becomes static This is a byproduct of overdosing on the omniscience which The Palladium provides.
Lyrics
[Verse 1]
I drink the palladium down
Till its fever names the room
A thousand borrowed years
Under drivers in my bones
I ask the dark, why do I dive?
What answer waits below?
[Breakcore Interruption]
Cut the thought—
Cut the breath—
Cut the silver into teeth
[Verse 2]
Old Luminara in my head
Was not the place Zenia knew
I keep her buried, call her gone
And make that absence true
A convent taught me shame as law
And purity as stone
I learned to judge my every shape
Before I learned my own
[Pre-Chorus]
Everyone was handed an ending
Warm hands, a door, a place to stay
I watched their stories close around them
While mine kept turning me away
[Chorus]
I wanted a world that would hold me
A world with no name for my flaw
I made myself sharp enough to rule it
I learned every hinge, every law
But power could open the gates
And connection could teach me the way
Neither could finish the work
I have chosen to finish today
[Breakcore Interruption]
No absolution—
No clean design—
The pulse breaks loose
The choice is mine
[Verse 3]
I stood alone among their laughter
Too frightened to cross the floor
Then made my mind a country
And claimed the waiting throne
I studied every tender signal
Till I could answer, reach, persuade
I mastered how to meet them
Still the hollow stayed
[Pre-Chorus]
I know what waits beyond this wanting
I know the cost I set in motion
I will not dress the blade as mercy
Or call my hunger devotion
[Chorus]
I wanted a world that would hold me
A world with no name for my flaw
I made myself sharp enough to rule it
I learned every hinge, every law
But power could open the gates
And connection could teach me the way
Neither could finish the work
I have chosen to finish today
[Bridge]
Not because it’s right
Not because I’m healed
Not because the dead will rise
Or the past will yield
I cannot call it justice
I cannot call it fate
I am the hand upon the latch
I am the will that makes it break
[Finale]
Every gorgon, every boundary
Every answer carved in stone
I will bring the whole world to its ending
If I cannot make it home
No pardon in the palladium
No innocence to claim
I know the thing I’m choosing
I will charge into its flame
[Outro]
I chose the road
I chose the cost
I will finish what I willed
Style Prompt
Dark theatrical progressive metal fused with breakcore, a rising villainous melody over a sick, tightly muted guitar riff that grows heavier toward a climactic final section, Begin with a restrained, intimate low-register vocal and sparse guitar; let sudden chopped breakcore bursts interrupt melodic phrases like fractures in thought, then return to the central riff with increasing force, Add tense strings and low synth weight as the arrangement escalates, ending in a charging, full-band finale, Female lead vocal, controlled and wounded at first, then resolute and commanding; raw-edged but articulate, Dense, punchy drums, abrasive breaks, dramatic dynamic contrast, polished cinematic mix

lyrics/the-blade-that-breaks-the-palladi.filePath: lyrics/The Blade that Breaks the Palladium.md
lyrics/the-blade-that-breaks-the-palladi.title: The Blade that Breaks the Palladium
lyrics/the-blade-that-breaks-the-palladi.content:
Prev: Zenia Remembers
Next: Luminara, I Remembered You
Background
The final battle between Cercei and Artemis/Zenia inside her headspace, her enhanced fully with the power of ACE and the Gorgon Neos who was released from the earth to enable her grand plans of universal customized Pass-Through.
Little did she know Artemis had Athena in her so she was rendered immune to the mind control. She uses Calantha’s return to destroy the Palladium cutting off Cercei’s life support and ending the Council Era.
Lyrics
[Verse 1]
Cercei: A century of order every thought in line
Palladium in my keeping every nerve is mine
IPv7, a kingdom in your head
I’ll make the past obey me or I’ll leave it for dead
[Verse 2]
Artemis: You knew me as your soldier when the gorgons crossed the seam
I burnt away my memories to learn the shape of your machine
Luminara still remembers what your iron towers cost
I carry Calanthas return to take back everything you lost
[Chorus]
Cercei: I’ll turn your fear against you
I’ll wear it just like a face
Artemis: I’ve met the dark that wore my face, it will not make me lose my way
Cercei: The mind is mine, the gate is sealed,
my will is steel, your hold will not yield
Artemis: In this head-space let the old world testify
One blade, one choice, one dawn, that code can’t falsify
[Verse 3]
Cercei: You stand alone inside my halls, no hand to pull you through
I’ll make your hurt, a throne and crown, the worst in you
The gray lord’s shadow comes again, the city bears my sign
Artemis: I am artemis the soldier, I can see your snares
Tenacious as i, the first frame pilot that made it to the air
The last gorgon’s fire still lives down beneath my skin
Cercei: - WWHAT? -
Artemis: I’m more than one, I’m more than the wound you’re reaching in
Cercei: Then drown beneath the names you’ve lost,
Artemis: I know each name, I pay the cost
Athena, stand beside me now, the princess doesn’t run
[Outro]
Cercei: The mind is mine, the mind is mine to keep
Chorus: The blade comes down, the old protection splits
Artemis: Like troy beneath the breaking sky, the palladium falls from on high
Athena spirit answers as the dawn invades these walls
You cannot bring the dark, we won’t become it, not at all
Luminara, rise again, your people still remember
I came back through a hundred years
[Post Outro Cercei]
I leave the door unchained
And now everything is not the same
Back to the way I saw it when all of this began
It’s beautiful
Style Prompt
Rock opera: stately strings and brass open around a distinctive Artemis-like distorted-guitar motif, then hard-hitting drums and guitars build into an orchestral swell, Two contrasting female character voices, theatrical and sharply articulated—one cold and commanding, the other clear, fierce, and resilient—join in a shared anthem chorus, Polished symphonic-rock production, escalating from a stately pulse to a driving, hard-hitting climax

lyrics/the-dark-that-wears-my-face.filePath: lyrics/The Dark that Wears my Face.md
lyrics/the-dark-that-wears-my-face.title: The Dark that Wears my Face
lyrics/the-dark-that-wears-my-face.content:
Prev: The Truth They Buried
Next: Palladium Fever
Background
A song about Zenia being taken into the headspace within the blade besides Sakuya’s dead body. It turns out to be a sword that trapped her mind after she failed the test she created to make sure it was used for good to end The Palladium.
Lyrics
[Verse 1]
Beside the still hand of a girl I knew,
A blade lay bright against the stone.
I took it up; the walls fell inward,
And every buried voice was known.
A ruined world stood up before me,
Its ash still clinging to my skin.
My shadow wore a crown of iron:
“Make Cercei pay. Lets flay her skin.”
[Pre-Chorus]
I knew that voice; it spoke in my own name.
It promised power, then fed upon the flame.
[Chorus]
I will face the dark that wears my face,
I will not become its throne.
Though grief can call itself justice,
I choose the hand that shields, not owns.
By every life the ashes took,
By every road my kin walked through,
I’ll carry what the blade was made for—
And let the tyrant fall in two.
[Verse 2]
Then Sakuya stepped back into my life,
A thought held fast within the steel.
She spoke of Calantha, the first trans hero,
A refugee who would not kneel.
With Athena at her side she battled,
With Artemis she learned to aim;
She led her sisters through the wilds
And gave Luminara its first name.
[Pre-Chorus]
Adopted by the huntress, bound by love,
A chosen line runs through my blood.
[Chorus]
I will face the dark that wears my face,
I will not become its throne.
Though grief can call itself justice,
I choose the hand that loves, not owns.
By every life that hatred took,
By the Wayfire my kin lived through,
I’ll carry what the blade was made for—
And make the tyrant fall in two.
[Bridge]
“I made the Palladium to reach them,
To read the heart I couldn’t know.
But power turns a bridge to prison;
I forged this edge to end its hold.
The IPv7 chain must close.
I could not master what I feared.
I sealed myself inside this weapon.
You still can choose my love, you’re standing here.”
[Breakdown]
My shadow raised the fallen kingdom,
Held every wound up like a law.
I lowered the blade—not toward the helpless—
But through the crown my darkness wore.
No revenge can mend the vanished.
No throne can give the lost their names.
I let the grief remain beside me;
It would not steer my hands again.
[Final Chorus]
I faced the dark that wore my face,
I would not become its throne.
Though grief still walks in my footsteps,
It cannot claim my heart as home.
For every love the Palladium took,
For every sister carried through,
I’ll carry what the blade was made for—
And make the tyrant’s ending true.
OH YEAH
[Outro]
I wake with Calantha’s Return in hand.
Sakuya’s last words in my chest.
The world is wounded. The road is waiting.
I rise—and take the next step.
Style Prompt
Epic fantasy soundtrack blended with driving symphonic rock and cinematic metal; guitar-led arrangement with a very gradual rise, low strings and pulsing frame drums giving way to taiko accents, distorted guitars, call-and-response vocal layers, broad orchestral strings and a soaring melody; polished dynamic mix, strengthening guitar and decisive orchestral ending; intimate female lead with theatrical delivery; tense minor-key verses opening into a triumphant driving full-band chorus

lyrics/the-truth-they-buried.title: The Truth They Buried
lyrics/the-truth-they-buried.content:
Prev: Luminara, I remember you
Next: The Dark that Wears my Face
Background
This is a song about Zenia chasing down the one weapon that has a chance of destroying The Palladium supposedly made by her closest living companion in the Kingdom Age who she was estranged with, Sakuya the Artificer
Lyrics
[Intro]
I take the back roads where the bright signs split,
A borrowed name, one careful bit.
Sakuya, you left a mark in steel—
I need the truth, not what they feel.
[Verse 1]
First town sells rumors by the byte,
A Gorgon map in a market of light.
They say the war began with a door,
Then every handshake asked for more.
IPv7—open, wide,
No veil between the mind inside.
Each wired thought has its own address;
Know it, and you can reach the rest.
[Pre-Chorus]
But locks don’t break by force alone,
A mind must slip and let you home.
I guard my name; I guard my breath,
And move between the lines they left.
[Chorus]
Across Luminara, town to town,
I chase the blade they buried down.
Your network meant to understand—
Now every link can close a hand.
I thought your heart was standing clear;
Why did you leave this truth down here?
[Verse 2]
Next node: old war songs, clipped and torn,
Gorgons rising, cities sworn.
The Council hunts a ghost they fear,
A legend passed from year to year.
They don’t know what the rumor names,
Still generations feed the flames.
A kill switch? Maybe. A judge in steel?
The stories change with who can deal.
[Bridge]
You built the link to hear us through,
Then watched the Council make it a cage.
They found you by the blade you made
To end the Palladium’s age.
You knew me. I knew you.
I thought your cause was good, though we disagreed.
But vengeance stood where dignity should be—
And you sealed your mind inside the deed.
[Final Chorus]
Across Luminara, town to town,
I chase the blade they buried down.
Sakuya, closest voice I knew—
I never thought I’d search for you.
One more gate, one more unknown,
A road that bends toward what comes next.
I’ll find the truth, then face the cost—
And carry what your silence left.
[Outro]
The towns blur past; the question stays.
I keep moving through the maze.
Style Prompt
Narrative rock-opera transition with a nimble rap-like vocal flow, female lead, driving guitar motif as the character’s signature instrument, clipped rhythmic verses that hop between distinct cybertown scenes, shifting grooves and brief instrumental handoffs, then a rising orchestral-rock refrain that points toward the next stage, Dramatic strings, tight live drums, agile bass, metallic digital textures, clear intimate vocal up front, wide cinematic mix with sharp dynamic changes, Preserve the supplied vocal timbre

lyrics/zenia-remembers.title: Zenia Remembers
lyrics/zenia-remembers.content:
Prev: Chaos in the Cadre
Next: The Blade that Breaks the Palladium
Background
Artemis finally remembers her true identity as princess Zenia after she absorbs the last Gorgon, Athena, fully actualizing and unlocking her memory. She declares her defiance for the council as she rockets back to earth from the seam to end the council now that she has everything she needs. At this point she has effectively brought an end to the Gorgon War.
A twist revealed in an uncreated song as of yet is that the goddesses of old Luminara are actually Gorgons and the original goddess Artemis sacrificed herself to become human and joing Calantha, her love, in mortal life.
Lyrics
[Intro]
The last eye closes; Athena is still
Beyond the seam, the dark bends inward
A silver gear turns under my skin
One buried name begins to surface
[Verse 1]
A gate of thorns, a garden wall
A red mark hidden in the stone
The truth they buried under ash
Returns in pieces of its own
I know the path beneath my feet
I know the hand that pulled me through
The names come back, the years unlock—
And every road runs back to you
[Pre-Chorus]
I…
I remember you…
[Chorus]
Luminara, I remember you
Luminara, I remember you
[Instrumental Climax]
[Verse 2]
Ampersat, I carry what you gave
Belial, your courage rides with me
I mourn you as I seal the frame
No grief can turn this course from me
Athena gave the last key back
The seam falls small behind my flight
Earth rises hard beneath my gaze
Calantha waits beyond the fight
[Rap Verse]
Cercei, hear the engines bite
I cross the seam and choose the ground
You built your rule on stolen truth
Now every locked door opens out
No crown, no code can make me kneel
No buried name stays buried long
I know the mission; I know the cost
I take the helm and carry on
For those who fell, for those held fast
For every life you tried to claim
I bring the truth, I bring the fire
And I am coming all the same
[Bridge]
The frame is closed, the course is set
Their names are here; I won’t forget
I turn for Earth. I choose the war.
I know what I came back here for.
[Final Chorus]
Luminara, I remember you
The gates, the gardens, what they stole
I bring the names they tried to lose
And take the future from their hold
[Outro]
Beyond the seam, I turn for Earth
Calantha calls. I answer now.
Style Prompt
Industrial synth-rock, measured 115 BPM build with a suspended near-silent refrain entrance, then a wide instrumental climax and decisive ending; detailed dramatic mix, centered intelligible vocal, wide strings, controlled distortion; sparse piano, breath-like pads, distant metallic ticks, cold arpeggios, marching snare, sub-bass, flaring distorted guitar, ceremonial brass, choir-like strings; low-register female lead, hushed and close-miked, growing into articulate forceful rap-rock delivery
